candidate_world_classification.R33_terminal: If R33 reaches a frozen tractable/empty terminal, preserve it as PRE_RUP_TERMINAL and do not count it as RUP generalization evidence.
candidate_world_classification.affine_terminal: If a stalled R33 residual is completely recognized by the frozen R34 affine terminal, preserve AFFINE_XOR_SAT/UNSAT and do not count it as RUP generalization evidence.
candidate_world_classification.RUP_UNSAT: If the frozen R35B mechanism terminates UNSAT_BY_UNIT_PROPAGATION with an independently replayable RUP sequence, classify candidate RUP success before truth verification.
candidate_world_classification.RUP_STALL: If the frozen R35B mechanism reaches STALLED_RUP_CORE, make no SAT/UNSAT candidate claim.

post_candidate_independent_verifier.scope: Verify the original generated CNF after the full candidate path is terminal. The verifier must not influence candidate routing, clause order, RUP proposals, or stopping.
post_candidate_independent_verifier.RUP_UNSAT_requirement: Independent RUP replay must pass AND Minisat22 must return UNSAT on the original world.
post_candidate_independent_verifier.affine_terminal_requirement: Frozen affine certificate must pass; Minisat22 additionally cross-checks the original world.
post_candidate_independent_verifier.RUP_STALL_truth: Minisat22 may label the stalled world SAT or UNSAT for diagnostics only; the candidate verdict remains OPEN_RUP_STALL.
post_candidate_independent_verifier.verifier_failure: Any contradiction between a candidate semantic claim and independent verification is SEMANTIC_MISMATCH.
